label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Wyndham Clark leads U.S. Open
items.text: Wyndham Clark is -7 overall through 1 at the U.S. Open, holding a six-stroke lead over Scottie Scheffler and others at -1.

items.headline: Dustin Johnson's LIV Golf challenge
items.text: Dustin Johnson is the only LIV Golf player who can still make the cut in all four majors in 2026 but must qualify for The Open at Royal Birkdale.

items.headline: Rory McIlroy out of US Open contention
items.text: Rory McIlroy fell out of U.S. Open contention following a poor back nine performance at Shinnecock Hills.
